reason: A native macOS companion that monitors DeepSeek Harness sessions through the DSH Web API and presents their status, attention signals, and connectivity in an always-visible interface.

summaries.zh: 一款面向 macOS 的原生状态岛，通过 DSH Web API 显示 DeepSeek Harness 会话的运行状态、关注信号和连接情况。
summaries.en: A native macOS status island that uses the DSH Web API to display DeepSeek Harness session states, attention signals, and connectivity.

capabilities: Reads session state from the DSH Web API
Displays live attention, failure, running, completed, idle, and offline states
Shows pending approval and question indicators without their contents in the collapsed view
Opens session links in the DSH Web UI
Stores endpoint, appearance, privacy, and panel-position preferences
Can register the app to launch at macOS login
